description: This file defines a React functional component named 'Moments' that manages user interface and logic for a feature called 'Moments,' which involves capturing and managing photos within the application. It interacts with application services, preferences, and UI components to provide functionality such as enabling/disabling Moments, selecting tags, and capturing photos.

methods.name: enable
methods.description: Enables Moments feature; activates premium modal if user is not entitled to files.

methods.name: toggle
methods.description: Toggles the Moments feature on or off based on current state.

methods.name: takePhoto
methods.description: Triggers the photo capture process within Moments, checking entitlement.

methods.name: selectTag
methods.description: Sets the default tag for Moments, based on user selection.

methods.name: unselectTag
methods.description: Clears the selected default tag for Moments.
